item.title: Armada Music Secures Sonique’s Full Catalog - EDM Sessions
item.description: Armada Music has cemented its position as a powerhouse in dance music by securing worldwide rights to the entire catalog of Grammy-nominated singer, songwriter, and DJ Sonique.

item.title: The Modern EDM Stack: Tools Every Artist Actually Needs (and the Ones You Don’t) - EDM Sessions
item.description: The modern EDM artist has access to more tools than ever—distribution platforms, analytics dashboards, promo services, content apps, and data subscriptions all promising growth. But more tools don’t equal better results. In reality, most artists are over-tooled and under-focused, mistaking activity for progress. This article is a clear-eyed look at what actually belongs in a modern EDM stack—and what’s quietly draining time, money, and momentum.

item.title: Sir Ivan Drops 'Love Is The Piece' — a Modern Peace Anthem - EDM Sessions
item.description: Sir Ivan returns as Peaceman with “Love Is The Piece,” a modern peace anthem that blends classic anti-war songwriting with contemporary EDM. Inspired by John Lennon and Bob Dylan, the singer-songwriter’s latest release delivers a powerful reminder that love remains the only path to peace — and that the solution begins within.

item.description: Paul van Dyk celebrates a major milestone as VONYC Sessions reaches its 1,000th episode, marked by a sold-out Berlin event, a new single, and freshly announced global tour dates—reinforcing his lasting influence on Trance and global dance culture.

item.title: How to Release Music Properly: The Details Most Artists Miss
item.description: Most music fails after release because of overlooked details. Learn how metadata, ISRCs, artwork, radio edits, and registration actually impact success.

item.description: As Miami Music Week barrels toward 2026, SHIFT Miami is doubling down on the blueprint it introduced in its first wave announcement — and sharpening its stance on what real industry access should look like.

item.title: Ophelia, Neon Owl Set Open Door Sessions at Shift Miami - EDM Sessions
item.description: During Miami Music Week, Neon Owl is linking with Ophelia Records for a focused industry gathering aimed at artists who want more than a handshake and a drink ticket. On March 26, the two brands will host a special edition of Open Door Sessions at The Clevelander South Beach.

item.title: 2026 EDMAs Reveals Nominees, Moves to The Clevelander - EDM Sessions
item.description: The 2026 Electronic Dance Music Awards (EDMAs) have revealed this year’s nominees and announced a major move to Clevelander South Beach during Miami Music Week. As the only fan-voted awards platform dedicated exclusively to electronic dance music, the EDMAs return with surprise performances, limited access, and expanded programming in partnership with SHIFT Miami — setting the stage for one of the week’s defining moments ahead of Ultra Music Festival.

item.title: The Recoupment Black Box: Does the Music Industry Need an Efficiency Audit? - EDM Sessions
item.description: Record labels invest millions developing artists, but much of that spending is recouped from the artists themselves. In an era of data-driven marketing and direct fan access, is the industry’s decades-old spending playbook still the most efficient way to build careers?
